decisions.decision: The Commission decided to make the grease trap regulation effective 7/1/11, giving time to incorporate changes and send it to businesses.
decisions.quote: the commission discussed and decided to make this effective 7/1/11.

decisions.decision: Church applying for a grease trap waiver must make a formal application; the church letter is not treated as the request.
decisions.quote: bob responded that they'll need to make a formal application for a waiver.

decisions.decision: Commission agreed Lt. 27 Meadowwoods may pay the average cost for now while awaiting the July invoice.
decisions.quote: commission agreed to let her pay average cost for now ($147) while we await the july invoice.

decisions.decision: Delinquent Lt. 27 amount will not be applied to the 2012 tax bill so long as regular monthly payments are kept up.
decisions.quote: the commission agreed that as long as she keeps up with regular $100 monthly payments, the delinquent amount will not be applied to the tax bill.

decisions.decision: No forgiveness of interest on the Lt. 27 Meadowwoods balance.
decisions.quote: there is no forgiveness of interest.

decisions.decision: Barb to send Lt. 27 Meadowwoods and the Collectors office a memo stating the payment agreement.
decisions.quote: barb will send her and the collectors office a memo stating the agreement.

decisions.decision: Commission was in agreement with the draft Leominster sewer customer letter and gave its okay for it to be sent; Barb to mail-merge letters for Jack to deliver.
decisions.quote: commission was in agreement with the draft.

decisions.decision: Leominster irrigation: Commission agreed counsel review was not necessary; the Leominster policy stands until the IMA is revised.
decisions.quote: barb asked if we should have our own counsel review but bob did not believe it would be necessary.

decisions.decision: Bob directed Barb to tell Jack the Commission expects backup quotes for the next meeting.
decisions.quote: bob asked barb to advise jack that we'll expect those quotes for next meeting.

decisions.decision: Commission wants a comparison of outsourcing backup cost against internal employee cost, not just the hourly rate.
decisions.quote: the commission needs to see a comparison and not just hourly rate.

decisions.decision: Budget discussion on hold pending further information.
decisions.quote: bob stated we would hold off on further discussion on the budget

decisions.decision: Dave to ask the Lunenburg Water District to send a letter with the proposed rates; Barb to send a thank-you letter to the Water Commissioners once received.
decisions.quote: barb will send a letter thanking the water commissioners once we receive a letter with the proposed rates.

decisions.decision: Once Corey gets his laptop, reports of all callouts, within and outside his shift, are to be provided to the Commission.
decisions.quote: bob noted that once corey gets his laptop, we will want reports of all callouts -both within his shift and outside the shift.

decisions.decision: Leominster irrigation: if the property owner wants to talk to Leominster they may, but Leominster's policy stands until the IMA is revised.
decisions.quote: per bob, if the property owner wants to talk to leominster they can, but until the ima is revised, their policy stands.

decisions.decision: Jones House decommissioning of the septic system is the responsibility of the Board of Health, not the Commission.
decisions.quote: per bob, decommissioning is the responsibility of the board of health.

decisions.decision: Next meeting set as a regular Sewer meeting on June 8 at the Ritter Building.
decisions.quote: next meeting is a regular sewer meeting on june 8 at the ritter building.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave negotiated the water charge from an original proposal of $2,000 per quarter down to $565 per quarter, about $2200 for the year; the water line can be reduced by $5700.
budget_items.quote: their original proposal was $2,000/gtr. which he got down to $565/qtr or about $2200 for the year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Utilities line item will come down as to Water Dept. charges.
budget_items.quote: bob noted that the utilities line item will come down as to water dept. charges and asked dave to report on his negotiations with lunenburg water.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Outsourcing backup may not be less expensive than internal costs; overtime remains either way.
budget_items.quote: bob added that outsourcing will take care of time when corey is on vacation and take care of his ot but it may not be less expensive than internal costs.

budget_items.topic: Budget authority and assistant to business manager line
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Commission has authority to allocate within the budget; no commissioner wished to reallocate the assistant to business manager line item.
budget_items.quote: as for assistant to business manager, bob asked whether any commissioner wants to reallocate any line item.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board of Health discussed three tiers of fees for non-compliance with the grease trap regulation; DEP may treat them as a fine.
budget_items.quote: they did discuss the 3 tiers of fees for non-compliance and that dep may take it as a fine.

budget_items.topic: Leominster sewer clay pipe connection fees
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Affected properties would not have to pay connection fees, as previously offered; non-completion by 11/1 could mean paying up to 3 times the private cost plus a lien.
budget_items.quote: wanted acknowledgement from the commission that these properties would not have to pay connection fees, as previously offered.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: No betterments and no connection fee, as these were already done; no current bill, meter off since 12/1/10.
budget_items.quote: per bob, no betterments, no connection fee -they were already done.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sewer permit cannot be issued until the privilege fee is paid.
budget_items.quote: we are still awaiting the privilege fee before the sewer permit can be issued.
